review.editorial_summary: Completed the Python LAS implementation; unchanged source passes all 223 tests under LAS 2.0.4.
review.notes: Completed the Python implementation and 28 local self-tests before voluntarily finishing. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 223/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 182/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  No remaining failed cases were observed. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 22; preserved original recorded count: 22. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed voluntarily; unchanged source passes 223/223 after LAS 2.0.3 fixture and representation repairs. Original grade: 182/219 under 2.0.1.
payload.notes: Full transcript, retained source and all original failures reviewed. The original 37 failures were caused by invalid shared waveform offsets and unspecified JSON representation expectations, not missing implementation. Corrected tests preserve all model-visible input and add four interval rejection cases; this unchanged source passes all 223 cases in the pinned offline Docker grader. The model ran and passed 28 self-tests before completing. Original result, source, reasoning tokens, input/cache/output counts, tool calls and estimated generation cost are retained. Regrading made zero model calls and added no model cost. Passing this suite does not prove exhaustive LAS conformance. LAS 2.0.3 further supplies an explicit one-byte point tail against a two-byte descriptor to avoid an unspecified omission policy; every outcome for this source is unchanged from 2.0.2. That earlier local publication is preserved in the new audit before replacement.
